citations.quote: in rising markets the arithmetic excess return is always greater than the geometric excess return and in falling markets the reverse is true

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Two excess-return measures: arithmetic a=r-b (vs initial capital) and geometric g=(1+r)/(1+b)-1 (vs the notional fund). Arithmetic exceeds geometric in rising markets and falls below it in falling markets; geometric is convertible and compoundable.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Arithmetic vs Geometric Excess Return
